fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The provider whose calls this row decides on.

fields.label: Direction
fields.description: Inbound is a call a patient placed; Outbound is one a rep placed from the CRM. Any matches both, and scores as the least specific.

How the call was routed by the provider: Dialer is an agent-dialled leg, IVR a call that came through a menu or queue. Any matches both. Every human-answered call in 363 captured CDRs arrived as Dialer.
fields.label: Channel

fields.description: Capture writes the call as a CRM Call Log. Ignore declines to — the raw payload is still stored and remains replayable. At equal specificity Ignore wins, so an exception can be carved out of a broader Capture row.
fields.label: Action
Enabled
fields.description: Unticked, this row is not considered at all.
